authorization: Active LoRa DURA goal directs isolated source-only mechanism diagnosis.

metric_names: source correct counts by seven views
paired net corrections and 95% receiver-stratified intervals

rows.method: Fixed exact-additive DURA vs region-wise known magnitude, direction, both, and projected magnitude

notes: Change only the requested factor for center and edges independently, with true-both and projected-amplitude auxiliary rows.
For each edited readout use its own deployed W24 center RMS. Clean variants preserve the frozen learned output.
The two true-noise quantities are offline source diagnostic inputs only. No candidate promotion or formal test originates from this run.
